name: Picture slime
doc: A slime mould that feeds on the picture: physarum agents sense their trail plus food ahead of them, the food being the picture's luma, so the web of veins grows over the bright parts and redraws the picture in its own colours (or the palette's). Mids widen the sensors, bass stretches their reach, loudness speeds the agents and thickens the veins, the beat makes them hungrier so the web snaps to the picture on the beat and wanders between; onsets respawn a burst on a ring and flash the veins.

in.doc: the picture: vein colours and the dim underlay

palette.doc: vein colours in palette mode, the onset flare

cells.doc: trail map height in cells (width follows the aspect)

food.doc: how strongly the picture's brightness pulls the agents (0 = plain physarum)

hunger.doc: the beat makes them hungrier: the web snaps to the picture on the beat

contrast.doc: gamma on the food (higher = only the brightest parts feed)

spread.doc: crowded veins repel, so the web spreads over all the bright parts

angle.doc: sensor angle in degrees (mids widen it)

reach.doc: sensor distance in cells at 540 (bass stretches it)

speed.doc: move per step in cells at 540 (loudness adds to it; rich food slows them)

react.doc: how much the music bends the sensors, speed and hunger

burst.doc: fraction of agents respawned on each onset (0 = off)

colour.doc: vein colours: the picture's, the palette's, or palette in thin veins and picture in the dense cores

exposure.doc: tone-map gain on the trail density
